about: GTA story length (Delta, pillar 2). HowLongToBeat, Grand Theft Auto V (howlongtobeat.com/game/4064, read 2026-11-16/17): players' averages Main Story 32 Hours (3,398 polled), Completionist 89½ Hours (982 polled). Derived: 89.54 / 32.06 = 2.8, 'nearly three times'. GTABase 100% guide (read 2026-11-17): Story Missions 55% (69 on the checklist), Strangers and Freaks 10%, Hobbies and Pastimes 10%, Random Events 5%, Miscellaneous 20%. No claim about GTA 6's length. Sources in BRIEF.md.
